Thumbs Off Your Phone While Driving!
Every year, too many people die because we can’t put
our phones down while driving. That’s why Nissan is
supporting the Red Thumb Movement as part of our
ongoing commitment to help reduce fatalities on the
road. So paint your thumbnail red as a reminder not to
pick up your phone when you’re behind the wheel. Find
out more at NissanUSA.com/redthumb
